en.access.nav.label: User and access management

en.access.matrix.subtitle: Who can read and who can write in every module, by role (read only)

en.access.teams.subtitle: Group people and, if you like, give the team a custom role

en.access.teams.confirmDelete: Delete the team? The people stay in the company.
